{{Quote|From Garqi we're not getting much, but all indications are that the Yuuzhan Vong have landed, assumed control, and are putting programs into effect for whatever their ends are.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="DTII" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]].<ref name="DTII" /> The planet was unprepared to resist the invasion and was quickly conquered.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|325|Garqi}}</ref> Garqi was ravaged and most of the population was enslaved by the invaders who depopulated the planet.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Survivors organized a [[Resistance (Garqi)|resistance movement]] against the invaders and Yuuzhan Vong turned the planet as a training ground for their [[Chazrach]] warriors. The New Republic later sent a [[Battle of Garqi|scout mission]] on the planet and discovered a flaw in Yuuzhan Vong [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|Vonduun crab armors]] as it came into contact with [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[bafforr tree]] pollen.<ref name="DTII" />
